description: This file implements the Response interface with the ResponseImpl class, managing a collection of logger data values and their timestamps for ECU communication responses.

classes.name: ResponseImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Response interface, storing logger data and value mapping along with a timestamp.

methods.name: ResponseImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the response timestamp to the current system time.

methods.name: setDataValue
methods.description: Associates a LoggerData object with a double value in the dataValues map.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the set of LoggerData keys in the response.

methods.name: getDataValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given LoggerData, returns zero if none is set.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the ResponseImpl object was created.
